items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: I was fortunate enough to be in the club and wound up being the MC on the show with Eddie Cleanhead Vincent, who was one of my favorite people.

ctx.x: What about, uh, what about the, like, Miles Davis?

Yeah, the Miles Davis, yeah. The Miles Davis. The Dizzy Gillespie. The Dizzy Gillespie. The Dizzy Gillespie. I played, I played all of that that way.
